description: Manual/API onboarding policy for platforms that must not be treated as live-capturable without authorized exports or approved APIs.

facebook.seed_schema: posts[] with post_id, url, created_at, text, optional media/account/canonical_url
facebook.live_capture_policy: Do not scrape unauthenticated public pages. Use Graph API, owner export, or explicit operator seed JSON only.

instagram.seed_schema: posts[] with post_id, url, created_at, text, optional media/account/canonical_url
instagram.live_capture_policy: Do not scrape unauthenticated public pages. Use Instagram Graph API, owner export, or explicit operator seed JSON only.

threads.seed_schema: posts[] with post_id, url, created_at, text, optional media/account/canonical_url
threads.live_capture_policy: Do not scrape unauthenticated public Threads pages. Use the approved Threads API path, account-owner export, or explicit operator-authorized seed JSON only.

linkedin.seed_schema: posts[] with post_id, url, created_at, text, optional media/account/canonical_url
linkedin.live_capture_policy: Do not automate public LinkedIn pages. Use approved API access, organization-admin export, or explicit operator seed JSON only.

x.seed_schema: posts[] with post_id, url, created_at, text, optional media/account/canonical_url
x.live_capture_policy: Treat live browser capture as degraded. Prefer official API, account-owner archive, public archive dataset, or explicit operator seed JSON.
